# Map libraries

Locally served, pinned upstream assets:

- `maplibre-gl.js`, `maplibre-gl.css`: `maplibre-gl@5.6.2`, BSD-3-Clause and included third-party notices in `LICENSE.txt`.
- `leaflet-maplibre-gl.js`: `@maplibre/maplibre-gl-leaflet@0.1.3`, ISC license in `leaflet-LICENSE`.

Files were verified against the SHA-256 integrity values in the matching unpkg package metadata. Basemap styles, vector tiles, sprites and glyphs are loaded from OpenFreeMap at runtime; the application keeps the map attribution visible. No API keys are embedded.
